result.summary: Found a major layout break at the bottom navigation bar where icons are clipped and obscured by a thick black bar, plus low contrast on inactive tab icons.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is visually broken - a thick black horizontal bar overlaps and obscures the icons, and the Search, Saved and Profile icons are clipped / cut off at the bottom edge. Only the Home icon is fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Fix bottom safe-area and layout padding so the tab bar sits above the system gesture indicator, remove the overlapping black bar artifact, and ensure all navigation icons are fully visible with adequate height

issues.description: Inactive bottom navigation icons (search, bookmarks, profile) have extremely low contrast and appear washed out / faint against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Increase icon opacity and use a darker gray to meet contrast requirements while keeping active state distinct
